newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 16 (Reuder) - Trade was quiet until about 1700 CDT, then fairly active. Slaughter steers and heifers were $2.00 per cwt higher than late last week. Inquiry good, demand light early, good late.
Wk to date- 50,300 Last week - 73,500 Last year - 13,300
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs, mostly 1200-1250 lbs 64.00, few 63.00. Dressed Basis - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 104.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1175 lbs, mostly 1050- 1100 lbs 64.00; few pens 1000-1075 lbs 63.00-63.50; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1175 lb heifers and heiferettes 63.00. Dressed Basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 104.00.

Sales confirmed on 15,700 slaughter steers and 19,100 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 50,300 head confirmed including 18,000 head or about 36 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
